descriptor: a watchman of Ashfold in a battered helm
notes: The watch (D-552). Present all round in settled areas, day and night, and the ONLY roamer that does not hunt on sight - it walks its round until it witnesses something, and then it goes after whoever did it. xp is deliberately ZERO: paying for a guard kill would make murdering the watch a farming strategy, and at a cast of three that is a better xp rate than the dungeon. It carries no loot for the same reason. Tough enough that one player alone should not want the fight and two probably win it - which is the intended shape, because the answer to the watch is not to be seen. UNRATIFIED.
